_readme: Our measured quality cells (the numbers in README.md tables). Protocol: greedy (temp 0.0), seed-1300 stratified selection for AIME, deterministic exec-grading. Hardware: single AMD Strix Halo 128GB, binaries as pinned in configs/. battery = the grader version the cell ran under. Dates ISO.

iten12.note: re-run 2026-09-19 under hardened grader: still 12/12; the one v3 failure was a grader bug (item 3 clock), fixed in v3.1
cloud-format caveat n/a: same contract as locals
format-compliance artifact suspected — see README footnote 7

aime.battery: v2 grader (exec fix) — re-run 2026-09-19: 10/12, identical to v1-grader cell

aime.note: 1 item INFRA (server died mid-battery). Graded-only: 8/11=0.727; counting the crash as a failure: 8/12=0.667 (ties IQ4_NL/27B). Both denominators reported.

protocol.grade: deterministic exec of the model's last python block; assertions on stdout (no LLM judge)
protocol.errored_items: spent, not answered — excluded from denominator, counted separately

aime_selection_split.note: seed-1300 subset is 8 of 12 from AIME 2025 (solutions ~18 months public — contamination-likely); 4 from AIME 2026. Year-stratified re-cut owed.

grading_changelog.v3 iten12 / v2 aime (2026-09-19): exec-namespace fix: structured solutions (functions, imports, recursion) previously raised NameError inside check() and were scored FAIL. All pre-2026-09-19 AIME cells ran under the broken grader and skew LOW for models that write organized code. Q5 re-run landed under the fixed grader; other models' re-runs owed.
grading_changelog.v3 iten12 additions: false-friend notkw rejections (items 1,2,7,12) + sentence-shape assertion (>=6 words) — keyword salad no longer passes.
grading_changelog.v3.1 iten12: item 3 accepts 5:45 PM == 17:45 (natural clock, matching the v2 items-7/9 precedent)
